description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class for AWS SDK's UseDualstackEndpoint feature. It provides methods to create configuration providers based on environment variables, INI config files, and fallback defaults, with support for caching and composition of multiple providers.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to generate AWS SDK configuration providers for the UseDualstackEndpoint feature, supporting environment variables, INI files, and default fallback configurations, with caching and provider chaining capabilities.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads the use dualstack endpoint setting from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads configuration from an INI file, with support for custom filename and profile.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when other sources are not set.
